title: Senior SDET
description:
At Securonix, we’re on a mission to secure the world by staying ahead of cyber threats and reinforcing all layers of our platform with AI capabilities. Our **Securonix Unified Defense SIEM** provides organizations with the first and only AI\-reinforced solution built with a cybersecurity mesh architecture on a highly scalable data cloud. Enhanced by **Securonix EON’s** AI capabilities, our innovative cloud\-native solution delivers a seamless CyberOps experience, empowering organizations to scale their security operations and keep pace with evolving threats.

  

Recognized as a **five\-time Leader** in the **Gartner Magic Quadrant for SIEM** and highly rated on **Gartner Peer Insights**, our award\-winning Unified Defense SIEM provides organizations with 365 days of “hot” data for rapid search and investigation, threat content\-as\-a\-service, proactive defense through continuous peer and partner collaboration, and a fully integrated **Threat Detection, Investigation, and Response (TDIR)** experience—all within a single platform. Built on a cloud\-native architecture, the platform leverages the Snowflake Data Cloud for unparalleled scalability and performance.

  

Securonix is proud to be a **cybersecurity unicorn** and to be featured in CRN’s 2024 **Security 100 list**. Backed by **Vista Equity Partners**, one of the largest private equity firms, with over $100 billion in assets under management, we have a unique advantage in driving innovation and growth. With a global footprint, we serve more than **1,000 customers worldwide**, including **10% of the Fortune 100**. Our network of **150\+ partners** and Managed Security Service Providers (MSSPs) enables us to deliver unmatched security solutions on a global scale.

  

At Securonix, we are driven by our core values and place our people at the heart of everything we do:

  

* **Winning as One Team:** We work together with universal respect to achieve aligned outcomes.
* **Customer\-Driven Innovation:** We innovate to stay ahead of the market and create value for our customers.
* **Agility in Action:** We embrace change and remain unified in our purpose and objectives.

  



We are looking for a **Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)** to drive quality engineering and automation across Securonix products, including **SIEM, ThreatQ (Threat Intelligence Platform/TIP)**, and associated cloud, microservices, data, and security capabilities.

 **Role Overview:**

  

As a Senior SDET, you will design and build scalable automation solutions across API, UI, backend, integration, and end\-to\-end workflows. The ideal candidate will have strong programming skills in **Python**, hands\-on experience with **Pytest and Playwright**, and a solid understanding of API and microservices testing. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and QA teams to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks using **Python and Pytest**.
* Build and maintain modern UI and end\-to\-end automation using **Playwright**.
* Develop automated test suites for API, UI, backend, integration, regression, and end\-to\-end testing.
* Drive an **API\-first automation strategy** for microservices and platform capabilities.
* Validate REST APIs, service\-to\-service integrations, authentication, data contracts, error handling, and distributed workflows.
* Validate data\-processing pipelines and data integrity using Python, SQL, and API\-based validation.
* Test complex workflows across Securonix products, including **SIEM and ThreatQ/TIP**.
* Develop reusable automation libraries, utilities, fixtures, test\-data management, and reporting capabilities.
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and enable continuous testing.
* Analyze automation failures, application logs, API responses, and backend data to perform root\-cause analysis.
* Participate in design and architecture discussions to improve testability, observability, reliability, and product quality.
* Identify regression risks and ensure appropriate automated coverage for new features and production defect fixes.
* Mentor QA/SDET engineers on automation design, coding standards, debugging, and testing best practices.
* Explore AI\-assisted testing and automation to improve test coverage, productivity, and defect detection.

  


**Required Technical Skills:**

  

* **5–8 years** of experience in Quality Engineering, Test Automation, or SDET roles.
* Strong programming experience in **Python**.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **Pytest**, including fixtures, parametrization, reusable libraries, and framework design.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **Playwright** for UI and end\-to\-end automation.
* Strong experience in REST API automation and testing.
* Experience designing or contributing to scalable automation frameworks—not only individual test scripts.
* Strong understanding of microservices and distributed architectures.
* Experience with SQL and backend/data validation.
* Experience testing complex integration and end\-to\-end workflows.
* Experience integrating automation with CI/CD systems such as Jenkins, Harness, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
* Good understanding of Git, Linux/Unix, debugging, logging, and defect\-management tools such as JIRA.
* Strong understanding of software\-testing principles, test\-design techniques, regression strategies, and Agile development practices.

  


**What We’re Looking For:**

  

* Strong problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and debugging skills.
* Ability to take **end\-to\-end ownership of quality** for a feature or product area.
* Ability to understand complex product architectures and identify appropriate testing strategies.
* Strong collaboration skills for working with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and other QA/SDET teams.
* Passion for automation, cybersecurity, AI, and modern quality engineering.

  


**Why Join Securonix?**

  

Work at the intersection of **cybersecurity, AI, automation, cloud, and large\-scale data platforms** while building quality\-engineering solutions for products used by global enterprises. This role provides significant ownership of automation strategy and an opportunity to influence how quality is engineered across Securonix product lines.

 **Benefits:**

  

As a full\-time employee of Securonix, you will be eligible for the following benefits:

  

* Health insurance with a total sum insured of INR 7,50,000\.
* Coverage for self, spouse, two children, and dependent parents or parents\-in\-law.
* Personal accident insurance with a total sum insured of INR 10,00,000\.
* Term life insurance coverage equal to five times the employee’s fixed base pay.

title: Test Automation Engineer/ Consultant Specialist
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.


If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.


HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.


We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist


In this role, you will:

* Implement end\-to\-end test activities (BDD, API testing, UI testing for browser and mobile, performance, security, exploratory, accessibility, etc.) in line with the Global Test Strategy.

To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements:

* Proven experience building and enhancing automation frameworks.
* Strong Quality Engineering and test management skill sets.
* Hands\-on experience with Core Java, Maven/Gradle, REST APIs, REST Assured/Karate, Selenium (WebDriver), JUnit, and Java IDEs.
* Good understanding of HTTP, JSON protocols and syntax, Cucumber, BDD methodology, Gherkin syntax, JIRA, Jenkins (CI/CD exposure), and Confluence.
* Working experience with Agile/SAFe practices, including in\-sprint automation.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

title: Specialist SDET
description:

Backed by an entrepreneurial, creative and energetic work force, teammates at AGDATA are pushing the boundaries of technology to enhance our relationships with our clients. We are a growing team, focused on adding creative, knowledgeable individuals who are ready to jump right in and make an immediate impact.


Visit us on www.agdata.com


More about us here: https://vimeo.com/347063684

**What’s the role?**


AGDATA is looking for an **SDET** to contribute to the design and building of our software offerings. If you want to have an impact and make a difference, AGDATA may be the place for you.

**Our ideal candidate will have…**

* 7\-12 years of experience as an SDET
* Strong experience of OOP design with **C\#/JAVA programming skill**
* 2\+ years of experience with **Selenium WebDriver and Grid/Cypress/Playwright**
* Ability to write complex **SQL queries** for data validation

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer - Assistant Vice President
description:

--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Key Responsibilities:**


Collaborate with development, product, and QA teams to understand project requirements and define comprehensive test strategies.

Experience in integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.


Knowledge of SQL for database validation.


Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.


Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate technical issues clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.


Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team in an agile environment.


**Preferred Skills \& Experience:**


Experience with Behavior\-Driven Development (BDD) frameworks like Cucumber.


Knowledge of performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner).


Experience with security testing concepts and tools.


Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).

description:

**About FIS**


Are you curious, self\-motivated, and forward\-thinking? At FIS, you will have the opportunity to work on some of the most challenging and relevant issues in financial services and technology. Our people empower us, and we believe in being part of a team that is open, collaborative, entrepreneurial, passionate, and above all fun.

 **About the Team**


This is an opportunity to join a talented team of functional and technical professionals working on digital banking solutions at one of the world’s leading providers of financial technology solutions. The team works across geographies and collaborates closely to deliver high\-quality, scalable, and reliable products for the financial services domain.

**Role Overview**


We are looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test, SDET, who is passionate about quality engineering, test automation, and building robust automation solutions for web, API, batch, and mobile applications. The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience in automation testing, requirement analysis, test strategy, and Agile delivery.


In this role, you will analyse business requirements, participate in grooming and estimation, design and execute test strategies, identify automation opportunities, build and maintain automation scripts, and help improve product quality based on defect trends and testing outcomes.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Analyse business requirements and actively participate in requirement grooming and estimation.
* Work closely with product owners, developers, quality engineers, and cross\-functional teams to understand features and define effective test coverage.
* Develop test strategies, create test plans, and execute test cases for new features, enhancements, and production support scenarios.
* Identify manual test cases that are suitable for automation and develop automation scripts using Playwright, Selenium, and other automation tools.
* Build, maintain, innovate, and continuously improve automation frameworks, test processes, and quality engineering practices.
* Automate testing across UI, API, batch, and mobile channels to improve regression efficiency and product confidence.
* Perform API testing for SOAP and REST services using tools such as SOAP UI and Postman.
* Validate applications through functional, regression, accessibility, mobile, and microservices testing.
* Write, implement, maintain, and review automation scripts and test artifacts.
* Use SQL to construct moderate to complex queries for validating data and troubleshooting issues.
* Participate in Agile development methodologies and sprint ceremonies, including planning, grooming, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Track, analyse, and manage defects while recommending quality improvements based on defect patterns and root causes.
* Collaborate across geographies and teams to support delivery, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
**What You Bring**

* Strong hands\-on testing experience with a focus on automating web and API tests.
* Experience in UI automation testing, API testing, and automation script development and maintenance.
* Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright and Katalon.
* Expertise in automation testing across UI, API, batch, and mobile applications.
* Experience developing or contributing to automation frameworks for enterprise applications.
* Experience on scripting languages such as Python, Ruby, Groovy, Shell, Perl, or similar.
* Strong understanding of manual testing concepts, test scenario design, test case writing, test artifact review, and defect management.

* Experience with accessibility testing tools and practices such as JAWS and Level Access.
